fact: The Zambia Cyber Security Agency is stated to exist and issue public statements, here a statement in Lusaka on 22 August 2026 (the document's published date).
The Zambia Cyber Security Agency is stated to operate, having moved into new offices on 20 August 2026 as its operational hub for responding to cyber incidents.
A Home Affairs permanent secretary states the Cyber Security Agency has been established and its director general spoke at the 30 July 2026 event (the document's published date).

The Cyber Security Act No. 3 of 2025 is stated to provide for the establishment of the Zambia Cyber Security Agency, which has a Director for Critical Information Infrastructure and is mandated to provide incident response services.
The SADC statement of 13 September 2018 says Zambia has an established and operational national CIRT.
The article describes the Zambia Cyber Security Agency (ZCSA) as operating and issuing a public advisory; it is dated by the article's publication, 2026-08-27.

The Cyber Security Act, 2025 (Act No. 3 of 2025) establishes the Zambia Cyber Security Agency in the Office of the President (s.3) and has it constitute the Zambia Cyber Incident Response Team (s.6) to handle incidents and issue alerts; the Act commenced on 12 May 2025.
The Zambia Cyber Security Agency (ZCSA) acts as the national agency under the Cyber Security Act No. 3 of 2025, issuing a public advisory on online misuse.
